meta.title: Demli — your friend group's own place
meta.description: Voice rooms, screen sharing, video calls and chat — all of it unlocked, with no paid tier. No ads, no algorithm, invite-only.

hero.phoneAlt: The Demli app on a phone
hero.title: The kettle's on.

voice.title: Sound is a setting, not a reward.
voice.desc: The channel runs at up to 128 kbps, and nobody upgrades a server to get it there. On guitar night, music mode plays 256 kbps stereo and the noise suppressor steps aside on its own.

screen.title: The top end isn't locked.
screen.desc: Whoever shares picks the quality: 480p through 2K, at 15, 30 or 60 frames. The camera runs 1080p at 60 frames a second. No line of that list sits behind a plan.

table.title: No discover page. Just invites.
table.desc: There are no public servers and no discover page; you join a group by invitation. No ads, no data sales, no algorithm ranking your feed.

r1.name: Baran
r1.title: Silence, at last
r1.body: Turned our loudest friend down with per-person volume. He's still shouting; we just can't hear it. The house is calm.

r2.name: Ece
r2.title: Guitar night, saved
r2.body: Switched to music mode and the strings stopped coming through as static. The group actually went quiet and listened.

r3.name: Mert
r3.title: Still looking for the upgrade screen
r3.body: Three months in and it hasn't tried to sell me anything. Suspicious, but I've made my peace with it.

r4.name: Zeynep
r4.title: The 2K stream
r4.body: Streamed the match and they asked who broadcasts this sharp. I picked it from a menu, that's all. Cost nobody anything.

r5.name: Kaan
r5.title: The APK thing
r5.body: Figured no Play Store meant no installs; turns out the app downloads its own updates.

r6.name: Elif
r6.title: No discover page
r6.body: Nobody can invite strangers, because there's no place to discover us. The table stays ours.

r7.name: Deniz
r7.title: Updates on the way out
r7.body: No wizard, no progress bar. Closed the app, next day it was the new version.

r8.name: Selin
r8.title: Came in from the browser
r8.body: Nothing to install on my Mac; the browser opened the same app. I looked for the missing screens and there weren't any.

r9.name: Emre
r9.title: Waited for the ads
r9.body: It's been a month. No ads, no go-premium nudge. Strange, but the good kind of strange.

footer.copyright: © {{year}} Demli. New versions arrive in the app on their own.
